description:
A three-hour private charter to the shallow backcountry channels where Atlantic bottlenose dolphins live and play year-round. Your USCG-licensed captain knows the local pods by behavior pattern, cuts the engines in the right spots, and you drift in quiet water — often within a few yards of the boat. This is not a captive-encounter tour. No feeding, no enclosures, no performance. We follow strict National Marine Fisheries Service distance guidelines for sustainable encounters.

Quick facts: 

• 3 hrs $995 
• Private 
• USCG-licensed captain 
• Perry Hotel & Marina 
• Fuel + safety gear included

what_is_included_items.value: Two bean bag chairs  (upon request at the dock)

what_is_not_included_items.value: Tipping the Captain and Crew: If you are satisfied, the minimum tip is typically not less than 20%.

itinerary:
Departure – Perry Hotel & Marina
Meet at Dock A, Slip #32. After a brief safety overview, we cruise into the calm Gulf and backcountry waters where wild dolphins are most commonly found.

Dolphin Search & Observation
Your captain navigates through known feeding and travel areas where Atlantic bottlenose dolphins frequently surface. We maintain respectful viewing distances while allowing natural curiosity to bring dolphins closer if they choose.

Pods may surface, travel, play, or occasionally surf the wake — every encounter is unique.

Wildlife & Scenic Cruising
Along the way, you may also see sea turtles, rays, pelicans, osprey, and other marine and bird life that thrive in these protected waters.

Optional Scenic Stop (Conditions Permitting)
Time and conditions permitting, enjoy a brief scenic drift in a calm area to relax and take in the surroundings.

Return Cruise
Enjoy a smooth ride back with unforgettable memories of your wild encounter.

special_requirements:
• Primary booking party must be 21 years or older.
• Children under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian.
• Guests must be able to board the vessel independently or with minimal assistance.
• Bareboat charters (7–8 passengers) require a designated renter 21+ to complete the Bareboat Agreement prior to arrival.

restrictions:

We strictly follow responsible wildlife viewing guidelines — disruptive behavior toward marine life will not be permitted.
